snippet.title: Far Far West - Playtest Trailer | Galaxies Autumn 2025 Showcase
snippet.description:
Yee-haw, cowboys! Grab your crew for Far Far West, a chaotic 1-4 player co-op shooter where you play as bounty-hunting robot cowboys taking on dangerous contracts for the Town Sheriff. Explore weird western landscapes — from dusty deserts and haunted mines to swamps and ghost trains.

Shoot fast, spell faster and survive together. Mix six-shooters with fireballs, craft your build with gear and perks, customise your robot cowboy and his steed, then team up with friends to blast monsters, sling magic and cash in on bounties.

The playtest is live now on PC. Wild times await. Wishlist now and be part of this bounty-hunting, magical western adventure.
